Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars and trucks. One day, Tim's mom told him to put his cars in the garage. Tim was very good at putting his cars in the garage.

Tim's mom was busy making dinner for Tim to play with. Tim didn't like to put his cars in the garage. He would laugh and run around the house. Tim's mom was not happy. She told him to lay his toys away before going to bed. Tim was sad, but he knew he had to listen to his mom.
